name: Razorfen Downs (Classic)
summary: Deep in the southern Barrens, the Scourge now holds Razorfen Downs, the quilboar's ancestral burial ground and capital. Led by the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer, its agents have raised the quilboar dead and threaten to spread their power across central Kalimdor.

sections.title: Capital of Thorns
sections.body: Razorfen Downs shares the towering, petrified vines of nearby Razorfen Kraul. It lies where the boar demigod Agamaggan fell in the War of the Ancients. For generations, this thorn labyrinth was the quilboar's sacred burial ground and seat of power, guarded by mystics of the Death's Head tribe. The quilboar hold its dense briars holy, for they were soaked in their divine progenitor's blood.

sections.title: A Scourge Bastion in Kalimdor
sections.body: The Scourge has broken the sanctity of Razorfen Downs. Amnennar the Coldbringer, a powerful lich who serves the Lich King, subdued the Death's Head quilboar and made their ancestral resting ground an undead stronghold. Reanimated quilboar skeletons and corpses, along with shrieking banshees, prowl the Spiral of Thorns. The Horde in the nearby Barrens and emissaries from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light both see this Scourge power as a grave threat to Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Razorfen Downs is the quilboar's ancestral capital and burial ground, cut through massive briars in the southern Barrens. The Scourge now controls it.

faq.q: Why are there undead inside a quilboar city?
faq.answer: Amnennar the Coldbringer, a Scourge lich, invaded Razorfen Downs, subdued the local Death's Head tribe, and raised dead quilboar to build an undead stronghold on Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the difference between Razorfen Downs and Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul and Razorfen Downs share Agamaggan's brambles. Charlga Razorflank leads the living quilboar stronghold at Kraul, while the Scourge now holds the Downs, their ancestral burial ground.

faq.q: Who rules Razorfen Downs right now?
faq.answer: Amnennar the Coldbringer, a Scourge lich, commands Razorfen Downs from deep within the Spiral of Thorns.

angles.text: A Scourge stronghold on the Barrens' southern border threatens the Horde's heartland and supply routes.
As an undead, you may draw the Royal Apothecary Society's and Undercity's Forsaken leadership's interest in investigating and purging the rival necromantic magic growing within the Downs.
